walkthroughs.summary: Four beats: what it protects, and what it refuses

beats.heading: Seven parts
beats.body: A command, a lease, a version check, a candidate, validation, the commit, and the announcement. Nothing else touches a board.

beats.heading: One writer
beats.body: The lease is taken before anything is read. Two agents cannot both be mid-write on one board, and the second waits rather than racing.

beats.heading: Two refusals, before anything is written
beats.body: A write built on a board that has moved is refused, and so is one that would leave the board incoherent. Neither reaches the file.

beats.heading: Commit, then say so
beats.body: The bytes land first. Only then does anybody hear about it — so nothing is ever announced that did not happen.
